current_evidence: The council's 'The local list' page links 'Download the local list' to download page 369, whose only file is this one, titled 'Draft list of local validation requirements (1 October 2023)'; the document text is dated 1st October 2023, and the LLVR consultation page (closed 18 Aug 2023) refers to adoption 'prior to 1 October 2023'.

issues.detail: The link is current but has expired by the council's own rule. It is the 1 October 2023 list, the council has published no review since, and by Nov 2026 it is more than 2 years old. The council's LLVR page says that unless a list is reviewed and republished within 2 years (DMPO art. 34(6)), its requirements 'will have no bearing' on validity. The file is also still titled 'Draft' on the council site, though the PDF itself is not marked draft and the local list page says 'A comprehensive local list has been agreed and published'. The workbook should note both points.
issues.evidence: Download page 369: 'Draft list of local validation requirements (1 October 2023)'; LLVR consultation page: 28 July-18 Aug 2023, adoption 'prior to 1 October 2023'

issues.detail: Many local list items are not captured at all: Affordable Housing Statement (urban 15+ dwellings; rural 10+ dwellings or >1,000m3; rural exception sites); Community Infrastructure Statement (Loggerheads Neighbourhood Plan area, 10+ dwellings or >0.5ha); Design Review (all major applications, schemes significantly affecting Newcastle Town Centre, sensitive areas); Heritage Asset Statement (development affecting designated or non-designated heritage assets or their settings); Hedgerow Assessment (removal of hedgerows needing consent); Landscape/Visual Impact Assessment (major development in the rural area); Open Space Assessment (10+ dwellings or affecting open space/sports facilities); Statement of Community Involvement (all major and major change of use); Structural Survey (reuse of rural buildings; demolition of listed buildings or unlisted buildings in conservation areas); Telecommunications Supplementary Information (all telecoms development); Town Centre Uses Evidence (sequential test; impact assessment for retail/leisure/office >2,500m2); Transport Assessment and Travel Plan (applications likely to generate significant traffic); Waste and Recycling Management (all new dwellings).
issues.evidence: List of Local Validation Requirements (1st October 2023) information items; e.g. 'Waste and Recycling Management: All new dwellings'; 'Design Review: All major applications'

issues.detail: Several application types show '(none)' although the source covers them. Outline omits Parking Provision Details, which explicitly applies to 'Outline applications where layout is not reserved'. Listed building consent omits the Heritage Asset Statement and the Structural Survey (demolition of listed buildings). Demolition in a conservation area omits the Structural Survey (demolition of unlisted buildings in conservation areas). Householder omits requirements that are not limited to non-householder cases, e.g. FRA ('all new development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 (including minor development...)'), Heritage Asset Statement and Tree Survey/AIA where TPO trees are affected. The prior approval types omit Telecommunications Supplementary Information.
issues.evidence: Parking Provision Details: 'Outline applications where layout is not reserved; all other applications involving parking'

issues.detail: Two items are placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)', which is a Staffordshire County Council function, not this district's list. Land Contamination Preliminary Risk Assessment applies to 'All non-householder applications' where contamination is reasonably expected (it mentions waste sites only as an example), yet it is absent from Full planning. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' quotes the Waste Management Facilities Safeguarding Statement, which applies to district development that might constrain a permitted waste facility. The real refuse item, Waste and Recycling Management for all new dwellings, is missing.
issues.evidence: Land contamination trigger: '...active or closed landfill sites within 250 metres of the development site, coal seams..., waste sites, transport depots and yards'

issues.detail: All 21 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the source's 'TYPES OF APPLICATIONS AND GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION(S)' column states the scope of each item. Examples include 'All major applications' (SCI, Design Review), 'All non-householder applications' (land contamination) and 'Major development in the rural area' (LVIA). Grokbot did not use that column.
issues.evidence: Column header: 'TYPES OF APPLICATIONS AND GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION(S) THAT REQUIRE THIS INFORMATION'

issues.detail: Most trigger excerpts are page furniture, policy-driver text or the wrong item. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' and 'Agricultural Land Classification' both quote the page footer (email/telephone/table headers). The real triggers are 'new agricultural workers' dwellings' and development on Grade 1, 2 or 3a land. Coal Mining quotes a table header ending '6.' (real trigger: Coal Mining Referral Areas, excluding Coal Authority exemptions). Air Quality, Arboricultural, Ecological and Parking quote only the 'Policy driver' references. Lighting Assessment quotes the canal land-stability text. Ventilation/Extraction quotes the Noise and Odour Assessment for new dwellings near a Waste Water Treatment Works. 'Design Code / Masterplan' quotes a footer for what is actually the Landscape Master Plan (strategic major; non-householder in or adjacent to the Green Heritage Network and rural area).
issues.evidence: Agricultural rows excerpt: 'Development Management, Commercial Development and Economic Growth, Newcastle-under-Lyme BC Website: e-mail: planningapplications@newcastle-staffs.gov.uk Telephone: (01782) 717717 INFORMATION ITEM POLICY DRIVER...'

issues.detail: Several triggers lose their thresholds. FRA quotes 'what information is required' instead of the trigger (1ha+ in Flood Zone 1; all development in Zones 2/3 including minor development and changes of use; critical drainage areas). Drainage/SuDS quotes the sequential-test sentence instead of 'major development... 0.5ha+ in critical drainage areas... canal buffer zones'. Foul Sewage quotes 'surface water/foul waters away from the railway' instead of major development, trade waste, or non-mains foul disposal. Noise quotes method text instead of the trigger (wind turbines; noise/vibration-sensitive uses or locations). 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' is misnamed (the source item is 'Biodiversity survey and report'), and its trigger keeps only the quarries/cliff-faces fragment of a long list.
issues.evidence: FRA trigger in source: 'Sites of 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1; all new development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 (including minor development and changes of use)'

issues.detail: Some rows are not local requirements. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is a Lighting Assessment fragment ('hours of illumination during the summer and winter. 2.'). 'Design and Access Statement' is a national requirement, quoted from a 'can be included within the DAS' note. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' quotes a sentence from the agricultural land item, not an EIA requirement.
issues.evidence: 'hours of illumination during the summer and winter. 2.'; 'The above information can be included within the design and access statement when this is required.'

issues.detail: 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' both quote the same Parking Provision/railway-boundary text. Neither is a separate item in the source; both belong to Parking Provision Details.
issues.evidence: 'Dimensions of visibility splays Where the access road, turning circles and parking spaces are proposed adjacent to a railway boundary an assessment of road vehicle incursion measures will be required.'

issues.detail: No tab items were extracted (tab_items is empty), although the reference row claims 24 requirement items. The source has about 33 information items.
issues.evidence: Source lists 33 INFORMATION ITEMs from Affordable Housing Statement to Waste and Recycling Management

summary: Grokbot links the correct and only published list (1 Oct 2023, still titled 'Draft' on the council site), but it is now past the 2-year review deadline. The extraction is poor: about 13 of the 33 local items are missing (including Heritage Asset Statement, Affordable Housing, Design Review, SCI and Transport Assessment), most triggers are page footers or policy text, and land contamination is wrongly filed as a county minerals/waste item.
